summary: The calls support a small set of first-property settings: role-based user groups, restricted Academy administration, date-based student lease terms when applicable, new Entrata vanity numbers, notice-unit availability, Blue Moon/NAA documents, and garage-style rentable items. Several foundational choices remain open—most importantly whether the first property is conventional or student, which website and CRM products will remain, and whether Hilltop will retain Elise AI. The latest direction favors conventional properties even though the original pilot consisted of two student properties. Calls c5 and c8-c15 contained no client configuration decisions.

settings.confirmText: Likely role-based groups — confirm with client: Which job roles should have separate permission and Academy enrollment groups at launch?
settings.meaning: Groups will control permissions, Academy access, course enrollment, and property-level responsibilities consistently when employees are added.
settings.assumption: Hilltop wants user onboarding and training assignments driven by job role instead of maintained separately in multiple systems.
reasoning: Hilltop wants one employee setup process rather than separate credentials and enrollment work.
Hilltop specifically discussed manager, accounting, and maintenance groups for automatic course assignment.
The exact launch group list was not finalized.

callsUsed.title: Entrata Academy - LMS Review
callsUsed.brief: The call was a discovery session to explore Entrata's LMS capabilities and how they could address Hilltop's training needs, particularly regarding compliance, professional development, and integration with their existing systems. Mary and Christina expressed interest in pre-built content, custom course creation, reporting features, and seamless integration with Entrata, requesting a course catalog and sandbox access for further evaluation. Entrata representatives outlined the features of Entrata Academy, including the Elite Tier for custom content and compliance courses, and discussed potential solutions for data migration and user access management.

callsUsed.title: Entrata + Hilltop - Pricing Discussion
callsUsed.brief: The call focused on negotiating a deal between Entrata and Hilltop, addressing pricing concerns, the scope of services, and implementation timelines for a portfolio of properties. Key discussion points included the 22% cost difference compared to RealPage, the inclusion of various services like BI and utilities, and the potential for a phased rollout starting with student properties. The goal is to finalize an agreement by the end of August, with a focus on finding mutually beneficial economics that can be presented to Hilltop's leadership team.

callsUsed.title: Hilltop + Entrata - Prospect Journey Overview
callsUsed.brief: The Entrata team demoed their platform to Mary and Christina, focusing on CRM, lead management, the application process, and integrations with existing systems like Knock and Elise. Key discussion points included lead source tracking, reporting capabilities, the application process, and the availability of training courses in Spanish, with Mary and Christina providing feedback and asking clarifying questions. The Entrata team committed to providing follow-up information and scheduling a scoping call to finalize details.

callsUsed.title: Hilltop + Entrata -- Scoping Call
callsUsed.brief: The call was a kickoff meeting to initiate Entrata implementation for two student properties, focusing on timelines, data migration, training, and defining roles. Key discussion points included the implementation process, required resources, and addressing concerns about data accuracy and workflow changes, with a target go-live date before Thanksgiving. Entrata also introduced their client success team and outlined their ongoing support model.

callsUsed.title: Entrata + Hilltop
callsUsed.brief: The team discussed baseball, personal anecdotes, and technical issues hindering their progress. They strategized on how to engage Alex and Jeff to move forward with a deal, including scheduling meetings and addressing software compatibility problems. They also explored ways to improve their presentation setup and communication.

callsUsed.title: Chorus - Entrata + Hilltop Residential
callsUsed.brief: The Entrata team presented their platform, including the Eli AI, to Hilltop, focusing on its unified database and AI capabilities for leasing, payments, and renewals. Hilltop expressed interest in marketing integrations, reporting, and the AI's voice quality, and Entrata proposed an on-site visit to address specific questions and ensure a good fit for a long-term partnership. Hilltop will discuss the proposal internally and provide a response.

callsUsed.title: Entrata + Hilltop Utilities
callsUsed.brief: The call was a sales pitch from Entrata to Hilltop Systems, focusing on Entrata's utility management services as a potential replacement for RealPage. Entrata highlighted cost savings, enhanced data visibility, and resident billing features, while Hilltop expressed interest in pricing and service levels, emphasizing their current satisfaction with RealPage and the need for a seamless transition. Ultimately, Hilltop will review Entrata's pricing proposal and discuss internally before proceeding.
